pick.name: Apache-2.0 core + proprietary ee/ folder, DCO sign-off
pick.what: Permissive core, paid features in a separate folder, DCO on PRs
pick.why: Maximises adoption; DCO lighter than a CLA

alts.name: FSL-1.1-ALv2
alts.what: Fair-source: anything except competing use; converts to Apache-2.0 after 2 years
alts.why: Best for hosted SaaS where clones are the risk; not OSI open source

alts.name: AGPL-3.0 + CLA Assistant
alts.why: Strongest OSI-approved clone resistance; CLA lets you relicense

candidates.name: Apache-2.0 + ee/
candidates.verdict: PICK for SDKs, MCP servers, plugins

candidates.name: FSL
candidates.verdict: For a SaaS app's own source

candidates.name: BSL 1.1
candidates.verdict: Similar to FSL, longer change dates

decision: Use Apache-2.0 plus DCO for anything meant to spread, FSL for a hosted app's own source, and AGPL plus a CLA only if you plan to sell commercial licences. verify with a professional.
